status: Exact finite-range certificate for the one-upper-knot region; not an unrestricted coverage certificate.

theorem.analytic_cap_bound: P(sum_i x_i D_i > sum_i c_i x_i) <= max_{1<=r<=n} (C_r/(C_r+c_n))^r when the threshold is at least x_(n-1), where C_r=sum_{i<r} c_i.
theorem.conclusion: The binomial Stringer value is at least the valid Gaffke upper limit; hence the pre-specified Stringer-Gaffke safeguard has zero uplift on that sample.
theorem.sample_condition: The binomial Stringer value is at least the largest observed taint.
theorem.stringer_specialization: C_r=1-p_n(n-r), c_n=p_n(0), and the r=n term equals alpha analytically.
